clusters.headline: New Delhi Air Quality Deteriorates Following Deepavali Celebrations
aiSummaryBullets: New Delhi's air quality index reached 303 as seasonal smog combined with the impact of firecracker displays during Deepavali.
The Central Pollution Control Board addressed discrepancies in reporting, while the Supreme Court highlighted vehicular emissions as a factor.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Belonging Triggers Political Policy Disputes
aiSummaryBullets: Sonia Gandhi's recently published memoir details her personal life, political challenges, and specific leadership decisions.
The Bharatiya Janata Party has critiqued the memoir, alleging the author exerted excessive influence during her tenure in the UPA government.

clusters.headline: Diverse Administrative and Industrial Developments in Tamil Nadu
aiSummaryBullets: Industrial activity continues with the opening of a new electric motorcycle center, while a workplace accident occurred at an iPhone parts facility.
State authorities are considering legal action regarding water management powers and are investigating procurement practices in local libraries.

clusters.headline: Multiple Passenger Train Derailments Reported Across Indian States
aiSummaryBullets: The Sairang-Kolkata Express derailed in Assam, resulting in multiple injuries and raising questions about recent track inspection procedures.
Four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express derailed near Kanpur Central station shortly after departure, though no injuries were reported.

clusters.headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Announce Milk Price Hikes Across India
aiSummaryBullets: Amul has increased the retail price of milk by two to four rupees per litre.
Mother Dairy is implementing price adjustments of up to six rupees per litre.

clusters.headline: Three Central Reserve Police Force Personnel Injured In Kulgam Attack
aiSummaryBullets: Three security personnel sustained injuries following an armed assault in the Kulgam district of Jammu and Kashmir.
The attackers, identified as two individuals on a motorcycle, opened fire on a security checkpost near Mir Bazar on Wednesday.

aiSummaryBullets: The Hindu reports: Amid call for Ladakh protest, CEO prohibits dharnas in Leh, Kargil over upcoming polls

clusters.headline: Indian Cabinet Approves Major Fertiliser Subsidy And Infrastructure
aiSummaryBullets: The government approved a subsidy of ₹62,370 crore for phosphatic and potassic fertilisers for the upcoming rabi season.
Officials attributed rising global fertiliser costs to the ongoing conflicts in West Asia and between Russia and Ukraine.
